messages:
kevin_infra: heads-up — I noticed a cert TTL mismatch in the prod path. edge proxy (us-east) is serving certs with ~7d left, but eu-backends report 90d. might be a sync issue from cert-manager -> KMS. anyone else?

marta_sre: saw related PagerDuty alert at ~00:10. cert-rotator job failed w/ transient KMS errors then retried. logs show repeated `AccessDenied` for Encrypt with key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999999:key/abcd-...

samir_sec: paste the exact audit log entry (auditbot). we need the KMS requestId and the principal. also pinging RBAC folks — could be a service-account mapping change after the last infra deploy.

kevin_infra: here's snippet from the rotator logs: ```
2026-03-19T23:58:12Z ERROR cert-rotator: failed to wrap key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::999999:assumed-role/infra/kevin_infra is not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999999:key/abcd-... (request-id: req-0a1b2c)
```

samir_sec: ok that's the principal. looks like the key policy only allows specific roles in eu-west. did we recently promote the rotator to run under `infra` instead of `cert-agent`?

marta_sre: deploy-bot shows a deploy around 03/18 that changed the cert pipeline runner image. yes, it switched to `infra` SA for better metrics. I can roll back, but would prefer to update key policy/role binding so new SA works.

jenna_ops: for mitigation we can flip proxy to use cached certs (short term) and move traffic to dedicated nodepool that still has rotated certs. but we should avoid reissuing certs until KMS RBAC fixed to prevent split-state.

samir_sec: agree. action items: (1) update KMS key policy to include `arn:aws:iam::999999:role/infra` OR add a resource policy that permits the specific encrypt call from the rotator role, (2) add an IAM condition on `kms:ViaService` to restrict cross-region use, (3) add audit logging filter for `kms:Encrypt` denies to trigger an alert.

kevin_infra: I'll open a quick PR to add `infra` role to key policy in eu-west, but want Security review before applying. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/2345

samir_sec: pls include exact least-priv actions and the `aws:PrincipalOrgID` constraint if possible. also let's update RBAC docs in `eng-security/ops` so future runner swaps don't break this.

marta_sre: also noticed mTLS handshake fails intermittently for client certs > 1s handshake time. suspect mismatched cipher suites after proxy update. can we enforce TLS 1.3 + specific ciphers on the proxy config? (we should avoid TLS1.2 ciphers that allow CBC)

kevin_infra: proxy config snippet I'm testing: ```
ssl_protocols TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
```

samir_sec: Make sure to run perf test — TLS1.3 has different handshake characteristics. Also ensure cert rotation agent continues to talk to the backend API using the new cipher set. add fallback policy in the console to route to eu-west-standby if handshake error rate > 1% for 2 mins.

jenna_ops: I'll add an alert: `proxy.mtls.handshake_rate` with threshold 0.01 over 120s and auto-annotate who rolled config.

auditor-bot: KMS policy change detected in staging 2026-03-19T12:04:22Z by kevin_infra. Added principal arn:aws:iam::999999:role/infra to key/abcd-.... Audit-ID: audit-7782.

marta_sre: thanks — let's hold prod change until security gives thumbs. samir, can you review the PR within 30m? if approved we can roll with a short maintenance window and run smoke tests (cert fetch + mTLS handshake + metrics check).

samir_sec: on it. quick checklist I'm using: 1) least-priv key policy entry, 2) KMS CMK grants reviewed, 3) auditlog filter in place, 4) rollback playbook updated (reference: /docs/playbooks/cert-rotate-emergency.md).

kevin_infra: ack. I'll prepare the maintenance note for #incidents and set a short window at 02:30 UTC.

jenna_ops: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate runbook and notify oncall.
